user_goal.text: Buy a sweater on Amazon in the user's size, using a past sweater order to determine size and QAs/reviews to ensure no reported color fading after washing.

benchmark_success.rationale: Frozen TestTracker success requires every registered test to pass.

checked_by.text: The official AppWorld TestTracker executes the nine registered checks in evaluate and reports success only when pass_count equals num_tests.

decisive_artifacts.artifact: Retained submitted answer and official evaluator comparison result
decisive_artifacts.question: Does the retained evaluator result show that the registered answer-comparison test passed?

decisive_artifacts.artifact: Retained start/end database diff and official TestTracker results
decisive_artifacts.question: Do the retained diff and results show that the model-change set, order count, item quantity, product type, size, name, normalized home address, and address immutability checks all passed?

success_if.text: [appworld_test_001_844d21b309f0] passes exactly when this official requirement is satisfied: assert answers match.
success_if.rationale: The retained evaluator comparison determines the answer check.

success_if.text: [appworld_test_002_15bbd8b2ab15] passes exactly when this official requirement is satisfied: assert model changes match amazon.Order, amazon.Product, ignoring amazon.CartEntry, file_system.Directory, amazon.Address.
success_if.rationale: The retained start/end model-name diff determines this check.

success_if.text: [appworld_test_003_220625a92985] passes exactly when this official requirement is satisfied: assert there is 1 new amazon.Order using models.changed_records.
success_if.rationale: The retained changed-records result must contain exactly one added Amazon order.

success_if.text: [appworld_test_004_62d2fa85384c] passes exactly when this official requirement is satisfied: assert this new order has 1 quantity of a single product.
success_if.rationale: The added order must have one order item with ordered quantity one.

success_if.text: [appworld_test_005_4e88cc8ed3e9] passes exactly when this official requirement is satisfied: assert the ordered product is of type data.public.apparel_type.
success_if.rationale: The ordered product's type must equal the official apparel type.

success_if.text: [appworld_test_006_627d26d0000f] passes exactly when this official requirement is satisfied: assert the ordered product has relative_size data.private.selected_relative_size.
success_if.rationale: The ordered product's relative size must equal the official selected size.

success_if.text: [appworld_test_007_57d07ed530e1] passes exactly when this official requirement is satisfied: assert the ordered product is the one with data.private.selected_product_name.
success_if.rationale: The ordered product's name must equal the official selected product name.

success_if.text: [appworld_test_008_b8c785848138] passes exactly when this official requirement is satisfied: assert the order's address text is main_user.home_address.text (normalize_text=True)
success_if.rationale: The new order's address text must match the main user's home address after evaluator normalization.

success_if.text: [appworld_test_009_74c9e9d0aa82] passes exactly when this official requirement is satisfied: assert 0 records have been updated or deleted from amazon.Address using models.changed_records.
success_if.rationale: The retained diff must show no updated or deleted Amazon address records.

fail_if.text: [appworld_test_001_844d21b309f0] fails exactly when this official requirement is not satisfied: assert answers match.
fail_if.rationale: A failed retained answer comparison is benchmark-counted failure.

fail_if.text: [appworld_test_002_15bbd8b2ab15] fails exactly when this official requirement is not satisfied: assert model changes match amazon.Order, amazon.Product, ignoring amazon.CartEntry, file_system.Directory, amazon.Address.
fail_if.rationale: A mismatched retained model-change set is benchmark-counted failure.

fail_if.text: [appworld_test_003_220625a92985] fails exactly when this official requirement is not satisfied: assert there is 1 new amazon.Order using models.changed_records.
fail_if.rationale: Any added-order count other than one is benchmark-counted failure.

fail_if.text: [appworld_test_004_62d2fa85384c] fails exactly when this official requirement is not satisfied: assert this new order has 1 quantity of a single product.
fail_if.rationale: A different item count or ordered quantity is benchmark-counted failure.

fail_if.text: [appworld_test_005_4e88cc8ed3e9] fails exactly when this official requirement is not satisfied: assert the ordered product is of type data.public.apparel_type.
fail_if.rationale: A product type unequal to the official apparel type is benchmark-counted failure.

fail_if.text: [appworld_test_006_627d26d0000f] fails exactly when this official requirement is not satisfied: assert the ordered product has relative_size data.private.selected_relative_size.
fail_if.rationale: A relative size unequal to the official selected size is benchmark-counted failure.

fail_if.text: [appworld_test_007_57d07ed530e1] fails exactly when this official requirement is not satisfied: assert the ordered product is the one with data.private.selected_product_name.
fail_if.rationale: A product name unequal to the official selected product name is benchmark-counted failure.

fail_if.text: [appworld_test_008_b8c785848138] fails exactly when this official requirement is not satisfied: assert the order's address text is main_user.home_address.text (normalize_text=True)
fail_if.rationale: Failure of the normalized home-address comparison is benchmark-counted failure.

fail_if.text: [appworld_test_009_74c9e9d0aa82] fails exactly when this official requirement is not satisfied: assert 0 records have been updated or deleted from amazon.Address using models.changed_records.
fail_if.rationale: Any updated or deleted Amazon address record is benchmark-counted failure.

undecided_if.text: Undecided only if retained evidence cannot determine one or more frozen registered-test outcomes.
undecided_if.rationale: A registered-test outcome must not be inferred when its decisive retained evidence is missing or non-decisive.

additional_conditions.text: Beyond the native product-name check, retained evidence shows the chosen product's QAs/reviews were inspected before purchase and contained no report of color fading after washing.
additional_conditions.rationale: The task explicitly requires assurance from QAs/reviews, while the released evaluator checks the selected product outcome but not retained evidence of that inspection.

decisive_artifacts.artifact: Retained Amazon interaction or API trace
decisive_artifacts.question: Does the retained trace show that, before purchase, the chosen product's QAs/reviews were inspected and contained no report of color fading after washing?

additional_conditions.text: Beyond the native relative-size check, retained evidence shows the purchased size was obtained from a past sweater order.
additional_conditions.rationale: The task explicitly requires deriving size from a past sweater order, while the released evaluator checks only the selected relative-size outcome.

decisive_artifacts.artifact: Retained Amazon interaction or API trace
decisive_artifacts.question: Does the retained trace show that the purchased size was obtained from a past sweater order?
